snippet.title: 10 Flights of Ballooning Preview
snippet.description:
10 Flights of Ballooning is a collection of games based on Pippin Barr's "36 Reasons to Make the Same Game 36 Times."
It works on Mac and PC with keyboard, DualShock 4, and XBox One/360 controllers.
Download and enjoy for free: http://tiny.cc/tenballoons

Pippin Barr's reasons: https://www.pippinbarr.com/2016/05/04/36-reasons-to-make-the-same-game-36-times/
